Section C – Case Information.Type of request – Select the situation t: Request for legal assistance and indemnification regarding a municipal ethics investigation into an alleged conflict of interest in a 2025 HVAC maintenance tender
Section C – Case Information.A detailed explanation of the situation: On 2026-04-08, the City Integrity Commissioner's office notified our company of an inquiry into the Q4 2025 RFP for HVAC maintenance covering the 120 King St. and 88 Harbor Rd. facilities. The complaint alleges that, as Procurement Compliance Officer, I improperly influenced the evaluation to favor NorthHill Mechanical Ltd. due to a distant relative employed there part-time. The events occurred between 2025-10-12 and 2025-11-06. My role was limited to running the compliance checklist (confirming mandatory bid requirements), opening bids in the procurement portal, and documenting timelines; I was not part of the technical scoring panel. On 2025-10-19, I filed a formal conflict-of-interest declaration with HR and my supervisor after recognizing a possible connection, and I was removed from the evaluation committee roster the same day. The evaluation was conducted by the appointed panel (Sofia Mendez – Facilities Engineering, Karl Pritchard – Finance, and Omar Haddad – Building Operations) without my participation in scoring discussions. All bid openings occurred in the shared procurement room via the eTender portal with audit logs. I did not receive any personal benefit, and I followed the Procurement Policy v5.2, including recusal and documentation. The Commissioner's office requested records (COI forms, portal audit logs, and communication) by 2026-05-02 and scheduled an interview during the week of 2026-05-13. I am requesting legal representation for the interview and indemnification because the inquiry stems from actions taken within my official duties, and I complied with company policy at all times. I have preserved the COI declaration, portal audit logs, bid opening recordings, Teams messages, and email correspondence, and I have provided copies to my supervisor and Compliance. A chronology and index of documents are available upon request.
